description: This file defines an interface IStream and a template class StreamType that extends a base stream class with additional functionality, within the WPEFramework::Core namespace.

classes.name: IStream
classes.description: An interface for stream objects providing methods to check if the stream is open or closed, retrieve local and remote identifiers, open and close the stream, and trigger actions.

classes.name: StreamType
classes.description: A template class that extends a base stream class with the IStream interface, forwarding calls to the base class.

methods.name: StreamType
methods.description: Constructor template that forwards arguments to the base stream class.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the stream is open by calling the base class method.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the stream is closed by calling the base class method.

methods.name: LocalId
methods.description: Retrieves the local identifier from the base class.

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Retrieves the remote identifier from the base class.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the stream with a specified wait time by calling the base class method.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream with a specified wait time by calling the base class method.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers an action on the base stream.
